svg.text: One passkey. The complete Earn cycle.
Monad → confidential balance → Ethereum vaults → fresh Monad wallets
One unlock · separate signatures · no wallet switching
Redeem from each position; remaining positions stay invested
Same investment wallets · separate Ethereum deposit addresses
One return route per investment wallet
Controlled by the same Mera passkey
Same passkey controls F, C, A1-A4 and R1-R3.
New addresses do not require new passkeys.
Public: chain transfers and vault activity.
Private: internal FAR balances and routing.
Amounts and timing can still correlate activity.
App coordinates separate routes; execution is not atomic.
